name: io.github.limuzi013/solidworks-direct
title: SOLIDWORKS Direct
description: Drives a running SOLIDWORKS session over its COM API: sketches, features, assemblies, drawings

environmentVariables.name: SW_MCP_OUTPUT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Every file the server writes stays under this directory; paths outside it are refused. Defaults to ~/Documents/solidworks-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: SW_MCP_TEMPLATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to look for .prtdot / .asmdot / .drwdot templates when SOLIDWORKS has no default configured. Auto-discovered when unset.

environmentVariables.name: SW_MCP_DEMO_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in basketball demo tools. Off by default, because they measurably degrade tool selection.
